experiment.limits: Fresh restore each run, same router and binary, 20 GiB total memory per node, no swap. Scratch MDBX files are individually fsynced/evicted and mincore-verified before startup, so restore cache cannot bypass node caps. Caps do not pin file-cache bytes. No global cache flush. One pass is not a confidence interval.
